title: QQ邮箱授权
description: 输入 QQ 邮箱地址和 IMAP/SMTP 授权码（非登录密码）。支持 @qq.com、@foxmail.com 邮箱。授权码仅保存在本机；在 QQ 邮箱设置中重新生成授权码或关闭 IMAP/SMTP 服务后，旧授权码即失效。
description_en: Enter your QQ Mail address and IMAP/SMTP authorization code (not your login password). Supports @qq.com and @foxmail.com mailboxes. The code is stored locally only; regenerating the code or disabling IMAP/SMTP in QQ Mail settings invalidates the old one.
docLabel: 如何开启 IMAP/SMTP 并获取授权码
docLabel_en: How to enable IMAP/SMTP and get an authorization code

fields.label: 邮箱地址
fields.description_en: Full email address, e.g. xxx@qq.com or xxx@foxmail.com

fields.label: IMAP/SMTP 授权码
fields.placeholder: 在邮箱设置中生成的授权码
fields.placeholder_en: Authorization code generated in mailbox settings
fields.description: 在 QQ 邮箱网页版「设置 → 账户 → POP3/IMAP/SMTP/Exchange/CardDAV/CalDAV 服务」开启 IMAP/SMTP 服务后生成的客户端授权码，不是登录密码
fields.description_en: Client authorization code generated after enabling IMAP/SMTP in QQ Mail web settings (Settings → Account → POP3/IMAP/SMTP/Exchange/CardDAV/CalDAV). Not your login password
